newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower as Thai market weakens.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower as Thai market weakens.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower on a weak tone in the benchmark Thai market along with fund selling, tied to long liquidation, traders said.
"There was long liquidation over the top of the market on behalf of funds due to the extreme rally early this week," a trader said.
New contract highs were set early with the new high for March at $12.45 per cwt, above the previous high of $12.39 set Thursday.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 700 contracts, below the 975 traded Thursday.
Rice futures closed three to 6-1/2 cents per cwt lower, with March down 6-1/2 at $12.32-1/2 per cwt.
